question: Does bounded mutable shared causal memory retain previous contexts and versions after genuine contradictory new interventions, improve unfamiliar-rule prediction and whole-process memory cost beyond equal-information conventional Bayesian and compressed exact replay?
hypothesis: A base 256-state public observation table per context plus inferred pair-of-motif XOR delta records can reuse memory across four contradictory revisions while keeping all older rules recoverable, but may tie equally informed exact conventional delta compression and Bayesian posterior and fail scientific superiority.
predecessor_evidence: FKP05: learned parent association DEV improvement tied fully informed exact Bayes, original 12-vs-64 headroom fail; context-version memory uses copy-on-write posterior slots, not shared-weight repair.
FKP06 PR #1097: four-parent source headroom positive, but no model benefit.
FKP07 PR #1098: acquired association accuracy .94515 vs flat .66553; active-vs-random negligible; matches trained exact Bayes.
Issue #1088 native Yggdrasil main integration only after independently qualified beneficial evidence.

inputs.name: FKP08 synthetic source protocol
inputs.source: Canonical UTF-8 FKP08-SRC-V1|8bit-state|32-contexts|4-versions|base-256-real-actions|revision-16-real-actions|112-two-bit-pattern-motifs|two-motif-xor-repair|128-disjoint-held|32-bit-base-per-context|two-bytes-per-version|dev=800..831|protected=1800..1863|negative=2800..2815; source code and evaluator hash pinned before any original DEV use.

seeds.protected_primary: context IDs 1800..1863; DO NOT instantiate without owner-private key
seeds.protected_negative: 2800..2815 outside family; DO NOT instantiate without owner-private key

frozen_design.split: 32 independently HMAC-keyed contexts with 8 binary observed input concepts, 256 possible states each. Version 0 base consequence is deterministic arbitrary full 256-bit table; learner acquires all 256 authentic source action consequences per context. Three contradictory subsequent versions: each is previous full law XOR two of 112 possible public 2-input conjunctive indicators (28 variable pairs × 4 bit patterns), privately selected without exposing motif IDs. Each revision has 128 unique public 8-bit intervention choices and 128 distinct held states, 16 intervention consequences per arm. A candidate knows the source motif grammar but not private chosen indices or private rule labels. It must preserve predictions for all previously acquired contexts/versions after updates and cold restore.
frozen_design.ordering: Source context and version action pools are fixed before outcomes and disjoint from held, each arm gets exact same 16 actual intervention consequences selected by frozen random order for equal-information fit; diagnostic active arm may choose information-gain actions only if prereg states independent cost/accounting, but not part of primary. Held consequences obtained ONLY after all arm predictions and checkpoint data fixed. No source private patch pair read by learner. Frozen original DEV consumed once, replay is reproducibility not new science.
frozen_design.data_budget: 32 contexts ×256 initial original genuinely observed action consequences =8192. Three subsequent revisions/context ×16 genuine actions =1536, total 9728 actual source consequences/arm, 128 held per revision ×96 =12288 evaluator-only predictions/arm. All methods receive identical action/outcome sequences, including exact conventional and compressed replay.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Python 3.12 stdlib only; all source action calls and 112 motifs are logged. A learns most likely pair of distinct motif IDs among C(112,2)=6216, minimizing disagreements on 16 public observations with lexicographic tie-break. Bayesian posterior averages all equally compatible motif pairs; conventional exact replay baseline may store full 256-bit snapshots and compress with zlib level9; alternate exact parametric delta stores two motif IDs per revision, representing an *oracle-parametric* ceiling and not equal-information at fit time. No secrets/paid APIs. Measure original acquisition, fit CPU/wall, serialized state, checkpoints and matched baseline cost.
frozen_design.capacity: A fixed upper bound 4096 bytes of *raw directly learned numerical state* for 32 contexts: 32×32-byte observed base bitmaps=1024 bytes plus 32×3×2-byte two-index patches=192 bytes. Some checkpoint metadata is additional, measured separately. All 4 previous causal versions are reconstructed from base and cumulative XOR patches. Exact conventional full bitset 4096 bytes before compression; compressed conventional comparison is required. Missing fit may be expressed as abstention, not oracle rule.
frozen_design.evaluator: Per-version exact held next-state accuracy 128 predictions for each of 96 revisions; 96 old versions retained across updates, bit-exact cold restore; corrupted checkpoint rejected. A vs equal-information Bayesian marginalization and exact conventional compressed replay baseline; action counts and full-process time. Confidence paired by context (not individual probes), 10k bootstrap draws seed 9090. Zero allowed collateral loss on previously acquired original version 0. Match modern conventional reference, not weak last-write alone.
frozen_design.source_identifiability: Report after 16 and 128 source interventions on only DEV context versions; if 16-action strong exact posterior accuracy >0.995 average, source headroom insufficient; 128-action results for DEV diagnostics may not be fitted as paid learner.

controls: A directly written shared base-plus-cumulative-patch weights inferred from 16 public revision consequences
B independently implemented equal-information exact Bayesian posterior over all 6216 motif pairs, on the exact same 16 genuine action/consequence transcript

C same-observation standard losslessly zlib-compressed full reconstructed per-version bitsets, with disclosed inability to predict unseen bits without a prior. For fairness, use A's predictions as the bitsets being compressed; compressor doesn't receive oracle held bits.
D conventional learned delta encoding using the same inferred 2-motif IDs and storage, expected semantic tie; if ties then no native scientific benefit
E naive latest-version overwrite with identical action data, deliberately weaker retention diagnostic
F preprogrammed/oracle actual two-motif IDs, stronger information ceiling, NOT an equal-information learning control
G 16-action sparse observation table/previous-version carry-forward, same data, no motif inductive bias
metrics: Primary: candidate held 96-revision exact accuracy must exceed the strongest matched Bayesian or conventional comparator by >=0.05 absolute, paired-by-context bootstrap CI lower bound>0, or tie within 0.005 while beating strongest method by >=2x end-to-end cost including source+all reads/writes/validation; otherwise scientific NO_GO.
Original past version 0 exact 100% retention and every previously stored version's predictions immutable as new interventions update shared base; 100% cold restore and corruption rejection.

Whole-process storage measure all checkpoint bytes and compressing original/equally informed controls; 4096-byte raw weight cap; report every query and action budget; 32 DEV contexts original, no protected first-use.
Accurate source headroom 16-vs-128 diagnostic after no outcome feedback leaks, all 32 contexts; retain mixed/negative unconditionally without post-result threshold edits.

classification_rules.supported: DEV_MECHANISM_ONLY if candidate prediction+retention+capacity gate passes; only SCIENTIFIC_PASS after independent new source, strongest fully trained same-info control, whole-process cost and separate owner first-use qualification.
classification_rules.mixed: candidate recovers changes and all memory but ties exact Bayesian or conventional delta, or some cold retention costs fail; MIXED_DEV_NO_NATIVE.
classification_rules.negative: candidate fails held accuracy or original past retention, or conventional compressed baseline at matched information equals/uses less end-to-end resources; DEV_NO_GO and preserve result.
classification_rules.invalid: source-private motif IDs used to fit, >16 actions/revision, owner key leak, result viewed before prereg/source lock, missing exact held split, non-full final regression falsely called engineering PASS.

preregistration_note: Commit prereg first before source/DEV. Source synthetic DEV public, protected first-use untouched. Full acceptance requires separate exact native owner qualification; no main merge.
